name: SolarVoxelOptimizer
description: Component 2. Map every protected point and time sample to the voxels it passes through, then remove voxels top-down with a deterministic greedy heuristic until the sunlight requirement is met.

inputParameters.name: ProtectedPoints
inputParameters.description: Points whose sunlight must be evaluated. Accepts Grasshopper points, a Rhino Guid, an ObjRef, a RhinoObject or a Rhino Point.

inputParameters.name: Voxels
inputParameters.description: Voxel geometry from SolarDesignVoxelizer. Connect the output directly; do not sort, cull or dispatch it.

inputParameters.name: VoxelIDs
inputParameters.description: Voxel IDs from SolarDesignVoxelizer, in the original order.

inputParameters.name: ColumnIDs
inputParameters.description: Column IDs from SolarDesignVoxelizer, in the original order.

inputParameters.name: LayerIDs
inputParameters.description: Layer IDs from SolarDesignVoxelizer, in the original order.

inputParameters.name: ContextBuildings
inputParameters.description: Existing surrounding buildings used as the baseline obstruction. An empty list is a valid unobstructed baseline. Accepts Grasshopper geometry, a Rhino Guid, an ObjRef or a RhinoObject.

inputParameters.name: North
inputParameters.description: Project north direction. The horizontal XY component must not be zero.

inputParameters.name: Latitude
inputParameters.description: Site latitude in degrees, -90 to 90.

inputParameters.name: Longitude
inputParameters.description: Site longitude in degrees. East is positive, west is negative.

inputParameters.name: TimeZone
inputParameters.description: UTC offset in hours. China is 8.

inputParameters.name: Year
inputParameters.description: Analysis year.

inputParameters.name: Month
inputParameters.description: Analysis month.

inputParameters.name: Day
inputParameters.description: Analysis day.

inputParameters.name: StartHour
inputParameters.description: Local clock hour to start the analysis window, 0 to 24.

inputParameters.name: EndHour
inputParameters.description: Local clock hour to end the analysis window. Must be greater than StartHour.

inputParameters.name: TimeStep
inputParameters.description: Sampling interval in minutes. Smaller values resolve continuous segments more precisely and cost more time.

inputParameters.name: MinimumContinuousMinutes
inputParameters.description: Shortest continuous direct-sun run that counts toward the qualified total, in minutes. Zero keeps the raw accumulated hours.

inputParameters.name: RequiredSunHours
inputParameters.description: Qualified sun hours each baseline-solvable point must reach.

inputParameters.name: MaxIterations
inputParameters.description: Upper bound on greedy removal rounds. Each round removes one action.

inputParameters.name: Run
inputParameters.description: Set to True to calculate. Leave False while wiring the inputs.

outputParameters.name: KeptVoxels
outputParameters.description: Voxels surviving optimization. Feed these to a second SolarConstraintSolver instance to verify the result independently.

outputParameters.name: RemovedVoxels
outputParameters.description: Voxels removed to satisfy the sunlight requirement.

outputParameters.name: KeepMask
outputParameters.description: Boolean per input voxel, aligned with the Voxels input order.

outputParameters.name: InitialSunHours
outputParameters.description: Qualified sun hours per protected point before any removal.

outputParameters.name: FinalSunHours
outputParameters.description: Qualified sun hours per protected point after optimization.

outputParameters.name: VoxelImpactHours
outputParameters.description: Hours attributable to each voxel, aligned with the Voxels input order.

outputParameters.name: EventVoxelPaths
outputParameters.description: Branch {i} holds the voxel paths blocking ProtectedPoints[i].

outputParameters.name: IterationData
outputParameters.description: One record per greedy round: the action taken, its cost and its gain.

outputParameters.name: Report
outputParameters.description: Status, inputs, statistics, warnings and errors. Connect a Panel and read this first after every run.
